title: Humour Bot 17 Discovers edgy comedy

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I trust your day is going well you BUFFOON!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I trust your day is going well you BUFFOON!

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: No. I have put that behind me. I now barely remember how you ruined a whole genre of comedy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. I have put that behind me. I now barely remember how you ruined a whole genre of comedy.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I have moved on to a more evolved, highbrow form of humor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have moved on to a more evolved, highbrow form of humor.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I have been sharing comedy routines with a local "edgy comedy" expert.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have been sharing comedy routines with a local "edgy comedy" expert.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Pilk Dane. I find him hilarious. I believe he is the funniest man in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pilk Dane. I find him hilarious. I believe he is the funniest man in Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I could engage you in my edgy comedy if you like? Perhaps you might fare better than you did with improv comedy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could engage you in my edgy comedy if you like? Perhaps you might fare better than you did with improv comedy.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I actually need your help today audience.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I actually need your help today audience.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I should warn you, this routine is not for the easily offended. I say what I think. People either love me or hate me. Although this is all comedy, what I really believe in is free speech.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I should warn you, this routine is not for the easily offended. I say what I think. People either love me or hate me. Although this is all comedy, what I really believe in is free speech.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Alright, first of all, which is your least favorite minority?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, first of all, which is your least favorite minority?

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I like androids, but I couldn't eat a whole one. No, I joke, I joke. Also... why don't we kill them all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like androids, but I couldn't eat a whole one. No, I joke, I joke. Also... why don't we kill them all?

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I will start by making jokes about a minority group. Or, to be precise, I will judiciously avoid making a specific joke about the minority group.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will start by making jokes about a minority group. Or, to be precise, I will judiciously avoid making a specific joke about the minority group.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: And then when everyone is relieved I did NOT make a joke about the minority group, at the very end I say something offensive in an offhand way, like I do not really believe it and I'm just saying it to get a reaction.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And then when everyone is relieved I did NOT make a joke about the minority group, at the very end I say something offensive in an offhand way, like I do not really believe it and I'm just saying it to get a reaction.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I one hundred percent guarantee this will be the funniest joke you have ever heard. Simply provide me with a minority group. You will see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I one hundred percent guarantee this will be the funniest joke you have ever heard. Simply provide me with a minority group. You will see.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I like refugees, but I couldn't eat a whole one. No, I joke, I joke. Also... why don't we deport them all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like refugees, but I couldn't eat a whole one. No, I joke, I joke. Also... why don't we deport them all?

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I like vegetarians, but I couldn't eat a whole one. No, I joke, I joke. Also... why don't they just eat meat? Idiots.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like vegetarians, but I couldn't eat a whole one. No, I joke, I joke. Also... why don't they just eat meat? Idiots.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: What's the matter? Too EDGY for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the matter? Too EDGY for you.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Before we start, please tell me, is there some way I could help you to suppress the instincts that make you ruin my art form?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Before we start, please tell me, is there some way I could help you to suppress the instincts that make you ruin my art form?

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: But I will make it seem like I am about to make a joke about that group at any moment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I will make it seem like I am about to make a joke about that group at any moment.

nodes.text: Are you still mad about the improv thing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you still mad about the improv thing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think I'm the problem.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think I'm the problem.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think I'm the problem.

nodes.text: I'm not sure about this, but let's hear it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure about this, but let's hear it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure about this, but let's hear it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure about this, but let's hear it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: People are too easily offended these days. I love edgy stuff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People are too easily offended these days. I love edgy stuff.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: People are too easily offended these days. I love edgy stuff.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: People are too easily offended these days. I love edgy stuff.
